```{=html}
<div class="screen-only">
  <b>WS-02-shadow-ai-usage-inventory</b> &middot; review copy &middot; declared format <b>A3 landscape</b> &middot;
  3 sheet(s). Each white page below is one physical sheet at true size.
  Anything spilling past a page edge onto this grey background is a layout defect.
</div>

<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Shadow AI Usage Inventory</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A governable register of actual AI tool usage and unmanaged data paths: the factual basis for the approved-tool list, the enterprise-tier business case, and the developer-preference evidence that stops a top-down mandate failing.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-02-shadow-ai-usage-inventory</b><br>
      Pack A - Groundwork (pre-work)<br>
      fill order <b>1</b> &middot; type <b>inventory</b><br>
      audience <b>eng-leader</b>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>The AI-Native Landscape</b>, <i>Two Buying Motions, One Problem</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch02-the-ai-native-landscape.qmd</code> L150-164 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch02-the-ai-native-landscape.html#sec-landscape-buying-motions">#sec-landscape-buying-motions</a>
    <br>&ldquo;How AI development tools enter an organization determines how governable they are.&rdquo; (ch02 L150)
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    This is pre-work. Nobody fills it in the workshop. Issue Panel A to every engineer in scope at least one week
    before Pack A (two for a large organization), one response per tool you use. Panel A is a survey, not an audit:
    field 2 is optional and a blank there is a valid return. The rollup owner is the only person who sees raw returns.
    A platform or tooling engineer fills Panel B across every repository in scope (sheet 3). Record the engineering
    headcount so the coverage denominator is real.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Panel A &mdash; usage census <span class="ws-block-note">one row per developer response &middot; fields 1&ndash;14 and coverage</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:4%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:30%"><col style="width:46%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>Team / squad</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="fnote">Choose from the organization&rsquo;s own team list.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>Respondent (optional)</b></td>
          <td class="prior">Marked optional on the form.<span class="prior-src">derived: amnesty note</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="fnote">Name or pseudonym. Blank is a valid return. Nobody is being audited here.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>AI coding tool in use</b></td>
          <td class="prior">Examples as prompts: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot<span class="prior-src">ch02 L152, L160 Q1</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="fnote">Every tool you actually use, one row each.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>Account type</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L160 Q2</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">personal</span><span class="opt">company-provided</span><span class="opt">free tier</span></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>Who pays</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L152</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">individual expense</span><span class="opt">team budget</span><span class="opt">central IT</span><span class="opt">nobody</span></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">6</span></td>
          <td><b>Monthly cost, if known</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-currency" data-symbol="$"></span><span class="fnote">Per-seat cost; feeds the enterprise-tier business case.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">7</span></td>
          <td><b>Covered by a data processing agreement?</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L152, L154</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">yes</span><span class="opt">no</span><span class="opt">unknown</span></div><span class="fnote"><b>unknown</b> is a meaningful answer; blank is not.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">8</span></td>
          <td><b>Visible in security audit logs?</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L152</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">yes</span><span class="opt">no</span><span class="opt">unknown</span></div><span class="fnote"><b>unknown</b> is a meaningful answer; blank is not.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">9</span></td>
          <td><b>What code flows through it</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L154</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">production</span><span class="opt">test</span><span class="opt">prototypes only</span><span class="opt">none</span></div></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Shadow AI Usage Inventory</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Panel A continued: preference evidence, exposure, disposition and coverage.</p>

    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-02-shadow-ai-usage-inventory</b><br>
      Pack A - Groundwork (pre-work)<br>
      fill order <b>1</b> &middot; type <b>inventory</b><br>
      audience <b>eng-leader</b>
    </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Panel A &mdash; usage census, continued <span class="ws-block-note">fields 10&ndash;14 and coverage</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:4%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:30%"><col style="width:46%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">10</span></td>
          <td><b>What would you lose if it were removed?</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&ldquo;What would you lose if the tool were removed?&rdquo;<span class="prior-src">ch02 L160 Q3</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="fnote">The developer-preference evidence.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">11</span></td>
          <td><b>Why did you choose it?</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L158</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">12</span></td>
          <td><b>Governance exposure</b></td>
          <td class="prior"><b>H</b> &mdash; production code, no DPA or DPA unknown, not in audit logs.<br><b>M</b> &mdash; any one of those three resolved.<br><b>L</b> &mdash; company-provided, DPA in place, visible in audit logs.<span class="prior-src">derived from cols 7&ndash;9</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-hml"><span class="pt">H</span><span class="pt">M</span><span class="pt">L</span></div><span class="fnote">Rolled up from fields 7&ndash;9 by the rollup owner. Not self-scored.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">13</span></td>
          <td><b>Disposition</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch02 L158, L215</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">approve</span><span class="opt">migrate</span><span class="opt">retire</span><span class="opt">investigate</span></div><span class="fnote">Set once per distinct tool at rollup, not per respondent.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">14</span></td>
          <td><b>Disposition owner</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span><span class="fnote">A named person per distinct tool.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num">&mdash;</td>
          <td><b>Coverage</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="responses returned &divide; engineers in scope (print both numbers)"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p class="fnote"><b>Amnesty note.</b> Shadow adoption happens &ldquo;not maliciously but inadvertently&rdquo; (ch02 L154). Field 2 is optional by design. This is a census of what is in use, not a performance record.</p>

      <b>Governed</b> &mdash; files exist, a named owner, and a change to them goes through review like any other code.
      Field 16 names an individual, not a team alias. Field 26: <b>mixed</b> and <b>unknown</b> are valid.</p>
```
